pivots.title: Drop XER format and demo; analysis modules relocated under schedule/
pivots.before: Dedicated XER parser (src/lib/xer/parser.ts, types.ts, wbs.ts, dcma.ts, progress.ts, sample.ts, sample-update.ts), XerLensTour component, XerDemo page (1302 LOC), XER-focused tests. XER was primary schedule format.
pivots.after: All analysis modules (aace, tia, dcma, chart-export, feedback, memo-export, progress) moved to src/lib/schedule/analysis/. Import retargeted to PMXML via src/lib/schedule/import-p6.ts. XerDemo deleted. No XER parser remains.
pivots.evidence: Commit d3a455d 'Dropped XER format and demo': 27 files, 603+/2897-.

pivots.title: XER flat-file import replaced by P6 XML (PMXML) pipeline
pivots.before: Schedule data entered manually or via ad-hoc XER parsing. No structured P6 XML import path.
pivots.after: src/lib/schedule/import-p6.ts (281 LOC) parses PMXML. New ImportP6Panel, ActivityInspector, CPM engine, baselines, calendars all wired to PMXML as canonical source.
pivots.evidence: Commits 6d325711 + 1161d080: +1390 lines, new DB tables (schedule_activities, calendars, resources) in migration 9262b81e.

pivots.title: TakeoffPro brand and GPS field-measurement page swept out
pivots.before: Product branded 'TakeoffPro'. GPS georeferencing workflow added 2026-03-27 (calibration UI, GPS-to-plan tracing, GPS field-measurement hero, 20 commits). Calibration table in Supabase.
pivots.after: Commit 'Swept TakeoffPro mentions' removes branding. GPS field-capture UI references removed from McfaPitch and plan.md. No dedicated GPS capture page remains.
pivots.evidence: Commit c1559f62. Prior art: 20 commits 2026-03-27 to 2026-04-11 all referencing GPS calibration/TakeoffPro.

pivots.title: Pivot to Supabase-backed projects; full schema established
pivots.before: Local/in-memory state only. No backend persistence. No auth roles.
pivots.after: Migration 20260321160419 creates app_role ENUM, user_roles, has_role() security-definer, profiles, projects, project_members, pay_items, calibrations, annotations, RLS, storage buckets, signup trigger.

pivots.title: Auth model expanded: org-based signup with invitation RBAC
pivots.before: Single user_roles table with role enum. No invitation flow.
pivots.after: invitations table (migration 20260323173825). Org-based signup; admins invite by email+role. handle_new_user_role() trigger auto-assigns project_manager on signup.

pivots.title: SpecViewer: text-dump approach replaced by PDF.js render pipeline
pivots.before: SpecViewer used text-dump / pre-parsed approach (specs-utils.ts extracted text statically). 276 LOC of text-parsing tests.
pivots.after: SpecViewer replaced with PDF.js rendering pages directly from stored PDF at TOC start page. specs-utils.ts stripped 209→shell; tests cut 276→~40. pdfjs-dist 4.4.168 added.
pivots.evidence: Commit cb06eeba: 4 files, 211+/586-. pdfjs-dist added at 600ec82c.

pivots.title: PdfCanvas: Fabric.js layer added for annotation drawing over PDF.js
pivots.before: PDF pages rendered via PDF.js to plain canvas. No interactive drawing layer.
pivots.after: Fabric.js (^7.2.0) layered on PDF.js canvas to handle polygon/line/count annotations, zoom, pan, touch.
pivots.evidence: Commits 263bded1, a201b36d, c54f1acd, 7c85aced. fabric ^7.2.0 first at f1922c42.

pivots.title: jsPDF added for PNG export and PDF summary generation
pivots.before: No client-side PDF generation; only PDF.js for reading.
pivots.after: jspdf 2.5.2 added. 'Added PNG export & PDF summary' wires jsPDF to generate summary PDFs.
